name: markdown-table-column-floor
description: markdown: in a width-constrained GFM table, no column may collapse below a readable floor while a long-content column takes the width, and a cell's enhanced entity chip stays inside its column - the observed live failure rendered 'GH Status' at ~2 characters per line because one cell's long max-content line stole the table (2026-11-19, hub session local:0350DTJsY0196rA6MHasBF)

mutation.declaration: markdown.module.css: .root :where(table) { table-layout: fixed } removed - auto layout returns, the evidence column's long max-content line re-collapses 'GH Status' to ~3 characters per line
mutation.note: Measured 2026-11-19 in the live hub: the same table rendered colW [27, 70, 31, 71, 223] in a 422px transcript column, and the standalone repro measured the 'GH Status' column at 37px (~2 content characters per line) before the fix and 84px after it.
